notifications.heading: The Replacing CMS apps will be unavailable on Saturday 25 April 2026, 20:00–23:00 BST.
notifications.bodyHtml:
A scheduled deployment will take the casework applications offline for up to three hours. Please save your work before the window begins.

If you need support during the outage, contact the service desk.

notifications.heading: Planned outage: Sunday 30 May
notifications.bodyHtml: The service will not be available between Sunday 30 May 00:00:01 and 11:00:00.
